CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.fact_orders
(
    order_id BIGINT,
    customer_key BIGINT,
    order_date_key INT,
    shipping_address_key INT,
    order_status VARCHAR(50),
    payment_status VARCHAR(50),
    shipping_status VARCHAR(50),
    total_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
    discount_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
    tax_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
    final_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
    created_at DATETIME2,
    updated_at DATETIME2
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'dimensional_model/fact_orders/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
);





SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN customer_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS missing_customer_keys,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_date_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS missing_date_keys,
    SUM(CASE WHEN shipping_address_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS missing_shipping_address_keys,
    CAST(SUM(final_amount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS total_final_amount
FROM dbo.fact_orders;





-- Fact_order_items


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.fact_order_items
(
    order_item_id BIGINT,
    order_id BIGINT,
    customer_key BIGINT,
    order_date_key INT,
    product_key INT,
    source_product_id INT,
    quantity INT,
    unit_price DECIMAL(12,2),
    discount_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
    tax_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
    line_total DECIMAL(12,2),
    created_at DATETIME2,
    updated_at DATETIME2
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'dimensional_model/fact_order_items/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
);





SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_item_id) AS distinct_order_items,
    SUM(CASE WHEN customer_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS missing_customer_keys,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_date_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS missing_date_keys,
    SUM(CASE WHEN product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS missing_product_keys,
    SUM(CASE WHEN product_key = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS unknown_product_items,
    CAST(SUM(line_total) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS total_line_amount
FROM dbo.fact_order_items;



-- Fact Payments
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.fact_payments
(
    payment_id BIGINT,
    order_id BIGINT,
    customer_key BIGINT,
    order_date_key INT,
    payment_method VARCHAR(50),
    transaction_id VARCHAR(255),
    payment_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
    payment_status VARCHAR(50),
    payment_date_key INT,
    refund_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
    payment_date DATETIME2,
    created_at DATETIME2,
    updated_at DATETIME2
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'dimensional_model/fact_payments/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
);



SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT payment_id) AS distinct_payments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN customer_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS missing_customer_keys,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_date_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS missing_order_date_keys,
    SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS missing_payment_date_keys,
    CAST(SUM(payment_amount) AS DECIMAL(20,2))
        AS total_payment_amount,
    CAST(SUM(refund_amount) AS DECIMAL(20,2))
        AS total_refund_amount
FROM dbo.fact_payments;


-- Payments status summary


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.payment_status_summary
(
    payment_status VARCHAR(50),
    payment_records BIGINT,
    affected_orders BIGINT,
    total_payment_amount DECIMAL(20,2),
    total_refund_amount DECIMAL(20,2),
    summary_created_at DATETIME2
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'dimensional_model/payment_status_summary/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
);



SELECT *
FROM dbo.payment_status_summary
ORDER BY payment_status;





SELECT 'dim_customer' AS table_name, COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows
FROM dbo.dim_customer

UNION ALL

SELECT 'dim_product', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.dim_product

UNION ALL

SELECT 'dim_date', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.dim_date

UNION ALL

SELECT 'dim_address', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.dim_address

UNION ALL

SELECT 'fact_orders', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.fact_orders

UNION ALL

SELECT 'fact_order_items', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.fact_order_items

UNION ALL

SELECT 'fact_payments', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.fact_payments

UNION ALL

SELECT 'payment_status_summary', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.payment_status_summary

ORDER BY table_name;
